source_quality_note: 2026H1 financial and operating facts are anchored to company disclosures and Shanghai Stock Exchange H1 context; scenario EPS, valuation multiples, probabilities and hurdle price are analytical assumptions. Formal decision price is the 2026-09-17 A_SHARE_FULL_MARKET close.

financial_quality.judgment: H1 growth is unusually strong and earnings quality improved materially, but operating cash flow is only about 31% of attributable profit, so the growth thesis is not equivalent to a cash-conversion thesis.

business_quality.judgment: AI infrastructure demand is translating into broad volume growth across GPU, ASIC and high-speed networking rather than a single-product spike. This supports the structural growth thesis, while customer concentration and hyperscaler capex cyclicality remain the central external risks.

cash_conversion_and_operating_risk.judgment: Cash flow improved sharply from a low base, but the absolute conversion ratio and low-margin manufacturing model require working-capital discipline. A sustained profit acceleration without corresponding cash conversion would be an invalidation warning.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: At 61.27 the stock is not conventionally cheap, but a normalized 2026E EPS around RMB2.65 implies roughly 23x earnings. The current price narrowly clears a 15% expected-return hurdle under the fresh scenario set, leaving limited room for execution disappointment.

thesis.core: Industrial Fulian's H1 evidence supports a structural AI-infrastructure scale-growth thesis: revenue, profit, AI-server/rack shipments and networking all accelerated. The 15% drawdown trigger is therefore not, on current evidence, a fundamental-break signal. The investable edge is continued AI rack/network share capture; the main counterweight is that the market already capitalizes a meaningful portion of this growth and cash conversion remains below accounting profit.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use FY normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB2.15/RMB2.65/RMB3.10. The base case assumes H2 remains strong but does not simply annualize Q2 acceleration; the bear case captures hyperscaler capex normalization/mix pressure, and the bull case assumes continued GPU/ASIC rack and networking scale benefits.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market may be overreacting to price drawdown versus the still-improving H1 fundamental trajectory, but valuation leaves only a narrow hurdle buffer, so ADD is justified only with strict price and cash-conversion discipline.

catalysts: Cloud-service-provider AI server revenue and GPU/ASIC rack shipments remain on a high-growth trajectory through H2.
800G-plus networking and SuperNIC growth sustains mix improvement alongside server scale.
Normalized EPS tracks or exceeds the RMB2.65 base case without a deterioration in operating cash conversion.
Customer diversification and new AI infrastructure programs reduce dependence on any single hyperscaler or architecture.
kill_thesis: Hyperscaler AI capex or customer orders decelerate enough to break the current GPU/ASIC rack growth trajectory.
Operating cash flow persistently lags profit and working-capital consumption rises despite reported earnings growth.
AI-server/networking mix growth fails to support margins, indicating scale without acceptable economic value capture.
Export controls, geopolitics or customer concentration cause a material structural loss of accessible demand or market share.
